title.zh: Ondo代币化股票及ETF上线Robinhood Chain
title.en: Ondo代币化股票及ETF上线Robinhood Chain

current_state.zh: Ondo brought 15 tokenized stocks and ETFs onto Robinhood Chain via cross-chain support from Ethereum and BNB Chain, while Uniswap launched 11 StablePair pools to supply round-the-clock DeFi liquidity for those assets.
current_state.en: Ondo brought 15 tokenized stocks and ETFs onto Robinhood Chain via cross-chain support from Ethereum and BNB Chain, while Uniswap launched 11 StablePair pools to supply round-the-clock DeFi liquidity for those assets.
